name: Utilla (sirkingbinx fork)
description: A maintained fork of Utilla, the library a lot of mods need to detect and join modded lobbies. Mods that say they need Utilla work with this one.

name: Utilla (PixelCattt fork)
description: Another maintained fork of Utilla, for joining modded rooms and running mods that depend on it.

name: Utilla Library
description: One file that covers both Utilla and GorillaLibrary, so mods built for either one work. Use it instead of installing both.

name: HoneyLib
description: A library that makes Gorilla Tag mods easier to write. You only need it if another mod asks for it.

name: StoneAge
description: A beginner-friendly modding library for Gorilla Tag. Install it if a mod you use needs it.

name: Scoreboard Attributes
description: Lets mods add extra info next to players on the scoreboard. A library by developer9998.

name: GorillaXS
description: Lets mods send notifications to XSOverlay, so you see them on your wrist in VR.

name: PrettyTrakkar
description: Logs when you join and leave lobbies, and can post it to your own Discord webhook.

name: Self Tracker (Zyber)
description: Posts the rooms you join to your own Discord webhook. Paste your webhook link into the text file that comes with it.

name: Self Tracker (imcrab)
description: Sends the rooms you join to a Discord webhook you set up yourself.

name: Astra's Self Tracker
description: Tracks the rooms you join and sends them to your own webhook. Set it up with the two text files described in the readme.

name: Lobby Logger 2
description: Keeps a list of your last lobbies in a text file and on a watch, so you can find a good room again.

name: Casting Tools
description: A small PC window for casters that makes joining room codes quick.

name: Leave and Join Random
description: Press B to leave your room. Press B again to jump into a random public lobby.

name: Room Joiner GUI
description: A simple PC window for hopping between lobbies.

name: Room Utils (InfoWatch)
description: Adds room tools to GorillaInfoWatch, like disconnect, join random and toggling room and map triggers.

name: QoL Tags
description: Small quality of life tweaks for PCVR players. Needs MonkeWatch.

name: LibrePad (imudtrust)
description: A free utility tablet with player info and music controls. This is imudtrust's fork of iiDk's LibrePad with a few fixes.

name: Better Gorilla Keyboard
description: An improved in-game keyboard that is easier to type on.

name: Embeddium
description: A small optimisation mod that tries to get you more FPS. Not related to the Minecraft mod with the same name.

name: FPS Boost
description: Another lightweight mod aimed at better FPS.

name: Steam Login on Rift
description: Lets you log in with your Steam account on the Rift version of Gorilla Tag. You need to own the game on both stores.

name: Lobby Code to OBS
description: Shows your current lobby code in OBS automatically, so you don't have to type it on stream. Add it as a browser source as the readme explains.

name: Live Sub Count
description: Shows a YouTube subscriber count in game.

name: Anti Modded Crash
description: Protects you from the common crash tricks people use in modded lobbies.

name: Don't Quit
description: Sends you back to stump instead of closing the game when you hit the quit box in a modded lobby.

name: W1NGZ Mod Checker
description: A free mod checker that shows which mods other players in your room are using.

name: Instel's Checker
description: A simple mod checker that shows what mods another player is running, without extra features on top.

name: Ace's Checker
description: Shows each player's colour code and whether they're on Steam or Quest.

name: Cortex Checker
description: A free mod checker for seeing what other players in your room are running.

name: Known System
description: Shows "Known" above a player's head if their player ID is on your own list.

name: WhoDis
description: Click a player to see their in-game info in a small panel.

name: NameTags
description: Puts each player's name above their head.

name: Astra's Name Tags
description: Shows each player's name in their colour, with their FPS underneath.

name: GT NameTag
description: A simple nametag mod that copies each player's chest nametag above their head.

name: Bingus + Qwerty's Nametags
description: Nametags that also show who's on Quest and who's on Steam. Unzip it and only put the BingusNametags folder in plugins.

name: Lozaros NameTags
description: A clean nametag mod. Open source under Apache 2.0.

name: Simple NameTags
description: Shows players' names above their heads. Nothing more.

name: Green Monkey's Name Tags
description: Shows each player's name, colour code and colour palette above them.

name: Unneeded Info
description: Adds extra info to the code of conduct board.

name: Top Maps
description: Turns the promo board into a rotating list of the top Virtual Stump maps.

name: Board Bibles
description: Shows Bible verses on the in-game boards. It pulls them from an online API and has an offline mode.

name: Gorilla Time V2
description: A PC window for changing the time of day. Press T to open it.

name: MonkeTime93
description: Changes the time of day and the weather.

name: Clear Weather (HYLODevGX)
description: Keeps the weather clear. Part of a small set of visual mods by HYLODevGX.

name: PokRD's Camera Mod
description: A fork of Pokruk's camera mod tuned to run better and record at 4K.

name: GTag Camera Mod
description: A recording camera with a floating menu you touch with your hand to change the FOV.

name: Camera and Casting Mod Archive
description: An archive of a couple of older camera and casting mods, kept so they don't disappear.

name: Fantasia
description: A shader pack that gives the game a soft fantasy look, mainly for recordings. Includes an experimental mod that makes the leaves move.

name: True Gorilla Trails
description: Adds a wavy trail behind every gorilla in their own colour.

name: RGB Monke
description: Makes your gorilla cycle through RGB colours, on your screen only.

name: Skull Mask
description: A custom skull mask hat you can wear in game.

name: Gorilla Cosmetic Tweaks
description: Small fixes and custom textures for cosmetics, and keeps them looking the same in first and third person.

name: Fake Code Redeem
description: A joke mod that makes every code look like it redeemed. It's only visual, you don't get anything.

name: COC Pickup Lines
description: Swaps the code of conduct board text for pickup lines.

name: Beyond Gorilla Fingers
description: Gives your gorilla physical fingers, like in Beyond Sandbox.

name: Gorilla Body (spinvrr)
description: Adds a full body to your gorilla, a bit like full body in VRChat.

name: Gorilla Body (working)
description: A working version of the Gorilla Body full body mod.

name: AutoBranch
description: Adds swinging and grabbing with natural arm movement.

name: Walk Sim
description: Walk around Gorilla Tag on PC like a normal first person game.

name: Sphere Buddy
description: Gives you a glowing sphere to hold and throw around.

name: Monke Bot
description: Adds a bot gorilla that can move around and talk. The author says part of it was made with AI.

name: GravityThigny
description: Lots of ways to mess with gravity. Only works in modded lobbies or when you aren't in a room.

name: Breathing Mod
description: A silly challenge mod where you have to hold a button to breathe or you can't play. Modded lobbies only.

name: GT Vinyl
description: A vinyl record player you can use in game, made for a modding contest.

name: JDP Horror Mod
description: A horror mod for Gorilla Tag that's still being worked on.

name: GT Legacy: Prehistoric
description: Lets you play a very early version of Gorilla Tag with multiplayer.

name: Gorilla Watch (Cody)
description: Puts the Hunt watch on your wrist in modded lobbies, with a bunch of tools on it.
